producer_report.summary:
Root cause: nothing checked that a reading agreed with itself. A criterion saying only some files change could disagree with the deliverables list, or exclude CHANGELOG.md. The producer followed one and the verifier enforced the other.

- **Check.** I added `check_scope_consistency` in `crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs`. It rejects a reading when a file-scope criterion names files but omits a deliverable. It also rejects one where the criterion allows a file that isn't a deliverable, or leaves out CHANGELOG.md while that file is a deliverable. Each error names the file. It is a heuristic over the criterion text, not a full parse.
- **Where it runs.** `build_reading` calls it right after `reading.validate()`, once the deliverables are normalized, so a contradictory reading fails before it is recorded or shown. `admit()` in `admission.rs` calls it again on the accepted reading and records a `reading-scope` violation.
- **Default and prompt.** `defaults.toml` gains a `changelog` default for code, tests, docs, config, build and prompts. I left the defaults version at 1, since adding `root-cause` earlier didn't bump it. `reader.md` now says to list CHANGELOG.md and keep file-scope criteria consistent with the deliverables.
- **Budget.** The longer reader prompt went over the 1800-token reader budget in the budgets test. I shortened other lines in `reader.md` to fit.
- **Docs and tests.** CHANGELOG.md and `docs/decisions.md` (new entry D89) are updated. I added tests for all four required cases (consistent scope accepted, omitted deliverable rejected, CHANGELOG.md excluded while listed rejected, no scope criterion accepted). I also added tests for a file allowed outside the deliverables and for the new default.
- **Checks.** `cargo test --locked` exited successfully, but its output was too long to read in full. I confirmed the key suites by re-running them on their own. Clippy with warnings denied and `cargo fmt --all --check` are clean.

checks_run.note: Exit status was success; the output was too long to read in full. The budgets and xtask policy suites were re-run on their own and pass, as did all athena-core tests earlier.

open_issues: The check is a heuristic. A scope criterion worded without 'only', 'exclusively' or 'no other file', or a file named with an unusual negation, is not caught.
The records.rs and briefs.rs deliverables were not needed, so I did not change them. The change did not touch the record schema or the brief rendering.
The reader prompt edits shortened some existing lines, such as the forecast and governance text, to stay under the budget. Review them for lost meaning.
Nothing in code requires CHANGELOG.md to be a deliverable for the listed classes. That part relies on the default and the prompt, as the reading assumed.
mistakes: My first reader.md additions pushed the reader set over its token budget. I trimmed wording in several existing lines to fit.
My first scope detection missed criteria that start with 'Only src/a.rs changes'. Two of my own tests caught it, and I added a check for sentences that begin with 'only'.
learnings: The reader prompt set has a hard budget of 1800 tokens (ceil(bytes/3)) in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs. Adding prompt lines or defaults means shortening other text.
Defaults render only the first sentence of each statement, so a default's first sentence is what costs reader budget.
defaults.toml was not version-bumped when root-cause was added, so the convention is no bump for added entries. I left the version at 1.
Admission violations are built with violation(rule, path, detail), and a violation with no path is allowed.
The next decision number was D89.
desires: A way to read a saved long tool-output file. The Grep hook denied a path outside the working directory, so I confirmed results by re-running narrower test commands.
The reader token budget and its headroom stated up front.
